title: 隧道管片防水墊圈安裝~Segmental-lining gasket installation
focus: 把止水墊壓縮、接縫偏移與長期鬆弛連到可驗證的水密性~Connect gasket compression, joint offset and long-term relaxation to verifiable watertightness
summary: 本課聚焦把止水墊壓縮、接縫偏移與長期鬆弛連到可驗證的水密性。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on connect gasket compression, joint offset and long-term relaxation to verifiable watertightness. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 壓縮量與溝槽幾何~Compression and groove geometry
units.title: 壓縮量與溝槽幾何~Compression and groove geometry
units.mechanism: 止水墊靠受壓變形建立連續接觸，壓縮不足留通道，過度壓縮又可能損傷橡膠或環片邊緣。應以實際溝槽和接縫幾何計算，名義墊高不能單獨代表安裝後接觸狀態。 假設有效原高20 mm、壓後15 mm，壓縮率(20−15)/20=25%；非任何產品的允收值。 溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。~A gasket deforms under compression to establish continuous contact. Insufficient compression leaves paths, while excessive compression can damage rubber or concrete. Actual groove and joint geometry, not nominal gasket height alone, governs installed contact. Assume effective initial height 20 mm and compressed height 15 mm; compression is 25%, not an acceptance value for any product. An overly deep groove can undercompress a correctly sized gasket, while grit creates point loading and adjacent paths. Uniform visible height can therefore conceal discontinuous contact where leakage originates.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設有效原高20 mm、壓後15 mm，壓縮率(20−15)/20=25%；非任何產品的允收值。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume effective initial height 20 mm and compressed height 15 mm; compression is 25%, not an acceptance value for any product.
units.verify: 量測止水墊、溝槽與實際縫寬，核對產品及環片核准圖面，對照力位移試驗曲線；品質主管需確認組合公差而非只驗單件尺寸，算例百分比不構成安裝規格。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。~Measure gasket, groove and actual gap against approved product and segment drawings and load-displacement curves; quality review checks combined tolerances, and the example percentage is not an installation specification. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: An overly deep groove can undercompress a correctly sized gasket, while grit creates point loading and adjacent paths. Uniform visible height can therefore conceal discontinuous contact where leakage originates.
units.failure: 溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。~An overly deep groove can undercompress a correctly sized gasket, while grit creates point loading and adjacent paths. Uniform visible height can therefore conceal discontinuous contact where leakage originates.
units.misconception: 只量止水墊原始高度就能知道安裝後的實際壓縮率。~Original gasket height alone determines its actual installed compression ratio.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄壓縮量與溝槽幾何的資料來源與適用條件。量測止水墊、溝槽與實際縫寬，核對產品及環片核准圖面，對照力位移試驗曲線；品質主管需確認組合公差而非只驗單件尺寸，算例百分比不構成安裝規格。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for compression and groove geometry. Measure gasket, groove and actual gap against approved product and segment drawings and load-displacement curves; quality review checks combined tolerances, and the example percentage is not an installation specification.

units.anchor: 水頭與試驗壓差~Water head and test differential
units.title: 水頭與試驗壓差~Water head and test differential
units.mechanism: 水密需求取決於地下水頭、內外壓及局部高度，不只是隧道埋深。試驗壓差須代表核准設計情境並保留溫度、持時和變形條件，不能把一次短暫不漏水等同全壽期性能。 假設淡水水頭50 m，壓差ρgh=0.4905 MPa；這是教學換算，未含設計裕度及暫態。 忽略感測器高程或管線損失會錯估實際試件壓差，過短持時又可能看不到慢漏；標稱水壓相同的兩次試驗因此未必有相同嚴格程度。~Watertight demand depends on head, internal-external pressure and elevation, not cover depth alone. Testing must represent approved pressure, temperature, duration and deformation, since brief absence of leakage does not establish lifetime performance. An assumed fresh-water head of 50 m gives ρgh=0.4905 MPa, a teaching conversion excluding design allowance and transients. Ignoring gauge elevation or line loss misstates specimen pressure, while short duration misses slow leakage. Two tests with the same nominal pressure can therefore impose materially different demands.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水水頭50 m，壓差ρgh=0.4905 MPa；這是教學換算，未含設計裕度及暫態。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed fresh-water head of 50 m gives ρgh=0.4905 MPa, a teaching conversion excluding design allowance and transients.
units.verify: 將試驗水壓計與試件高程校正，核對供水側及量測側壓力，觀察持時漏量與接縫幾何；試驗負責人依核准規格判定，不採用本課水頭自訂產品認證。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：忽略感測器高程或管線損失會錯估實際試件壓差，過短持時又可能看不到慢漏；標稱水壓相同的兩次試驗因此未必有相同嚴格程度。~Correct pressure for gauge and specimen elevation and compare supply and measured sides while monitoring duration, leakage and gap geometry; test leads apply the approved specification, not an improvised product certification based on this example. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ignoring gauge elevation or line loss misstates specimen pressure, while short duration misses slow leakage. Two tests with the same nominal pressure can therefore impose materially different demands.
units.failure: 忽略感測器高程或管線損失會錯估實際試件壓差，過短持時又可能看不到慢漏；標稱水壓相同的兩次試驗因此未必有相同嚴格程度。~Ignoring gauge elevation or line loss misstates specimen pressure, while short duration misses slow leakage. Two tests with the same nominal pressure can therefore impose materially different demands.
units.misconception: 短時間不漏水就保證所有老化和變形情境都合格。~Brief absence of leakage proves adequacy under every aging and deformation scenario.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄水頭與試驗壓差的資料來源與適用條件。將試驗水壓計與試件高程校正，核對供水側及量測側壓力，觀察持時漏量與接縫幾何；試驗負責人依核准規格判定，不採用本課水頭自訂產品認證。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for water head and test differential. Correct pressure for gauge and specimen elevation and compare supply and measured sides while monitoring duration, leakage and gap geometry; test leads apply the approved specification, not an improvised product certification based on this example.

units.anchor: 錯台與接觸寬度~Offset and contact width
units.title: 錯台與接觸寬度~Offset and contact width
units.mechanism: 接縫錯台使兩側止水墊橫向錯開，接觸寬度下降並可能扭轉局部橡膠。縫寬和錯台應組合評估，同一錯台在不同壓縮量下可有不同水密效果，不能分項合格就推定組合合格。 假設簡化接觸寬30 mm、錯台5 mm，幾何重疊25 mm、保留83.3%；未包含橡膠側向變形。 兩項各自接近允許邊界時組合可能失水密，錯台集中於角部又更不利；只用平均縫寬會把局部接觸寬度不足掩蓋掉。~Joint offset reduces overlapping contact and may twist rubber. Gap and offset interact, with the same offset behaving differently at different compression, so separate dimensional compliance does not establish combined watertightness. Assume nominal contact width 30 mm and offset 5 mm; geometric overlap is 25 mm or 83.3%, excluding lateral rubber deformation. Two individually acceptable near-limit dimensions can fail when combined, especially at corners. Mean gap measurements conceal local loss of contact width and the continuous leakage path it can create.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設簡化接觸寬30 mm、錯台5 mm，幾何重疊25 mm、保留83.3%；未包含橡膠側向變形。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume nominal contact width 30 mm and offset 5 mm; geometric overlap is 25 mm or 83.3%, excluding lateral rubber deformation.
units.verify: 以代表性最不利縫寬和錯台組合做核准水密試驗，記錄接觸印痕及漏點；測量安裝後幾何時保留方位，品質主管需確認組合落在試驗覆蓋範圍而非只比較單一公差。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：兩項各自接近允許邊界時組合可能失水密，錯台集中於角部又更不利；只用平均縫寬會把局部接觸寬度不足掩蓋掉。~Test approved adverse gap-offset combinations and record contact impressions and leak paths; preserve angular position in installed measurements and verify that combinations fall inside tested coverage rather than checking isolated tolerances. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Two individually acceptable near-limit dimensions can fail when combined, especially at corners. Mean gap measurements conceal local loss of contact width and the continuous leakage path it can create.
units.failure: 兩項各自接近允許邊界時組合可能失水密，錯台集中於角部又更不利；只用平均縫寬會把局部接觸寬度不足掩蓋掉。~Two individually acceptable near-limit dimensions can fail when combined, especially at corners. Mean gap measurements conceal local loss of contact width and the continuous leakage path it can create.
units.misconception: 縫寬和錯台分別合格就代表任何組合都一定水密。~Separate gap and offset compliance guarantees watertightness for every combination.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄錯台與接觸寬度的資料來源與適用條件。以代表性最不利縫寬和錯台組合做核准水密試驗，記錄接觸印痕及漏點；測量安裝後幾何時保留方位，品質主管需確認組合落在試驗覆蓋範圍而非只比較單一公差。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for offset and contact width. Test approved adverse gap-offset combinations and record contact impressions and leak paths; preserve angular position in installed measurements and verify that combinations fall inside tested coverage rather than checking isolated tolerances.

units.anchor: 壓縮反力與混凝土~Compression force and concrete
units.title: 壓縮反力與混凝土~Compression force and concrete
units.mechanism: 止水墊反力由接縫閉合傳到混凝土溝槽，過高剛度會增加組裝力與局部劈裂風險。水密接觸與環片局部強度必須協同，不可只選反力越大的墊材而忽略周邊混凝土。 假設每米密封線反力30 kN/m、長2 m，合力60 kN；局部溝槽應力仍需接觸面積與構造分析。 高反力可在尚未出現滲漏前損傷溝槽邊緣，裂損後幾何又降低密封效果；只用橡膠材料試驗無法看出這種系統性反作用。~Gasket compression transmits reaction into the concrete groove. Excess stiffness increases closure force and local splitting risk, so sealing contact and concrete resistance require joint design rather than selecting the stiffest gasket automatically. Assume line reaction 30 kN/m over 2 m; total force is 60 kN, while groove stress still requires contact area and detailing analysis. High reaction can crack groove edges before leakage appears, and damaged geometry then undermines sealing. Rubber-only material tests do not reveal this coupled system failure mechanism under assembly loading.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設每米密封線反力30 kN/m、長2 m，合力60 kN；局部溝槽應力仍需接觸面積與構造分析。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume line reaction 30 kN/m over 2 m; total force is 60 kN, while groove stress still requires contact area and detailing analysis.
units.verify: 以實際溝槽試件量測力位移並檢查混凝土裂縫，對照環片配筋與角部細節；試驗須涵蓋組裝變形，結構及止水設計者共同確認力與水密的相容性。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：高反力可在尚未出現滲漏前損傷溝槽邊緣，裂損後幾何又降低密封效果；只用橡膠材料試驗無法看出這種系統性反作用。~Measure load-displacement in representative grooves and inspect concrete cracking against reinforcement and corner details; include assembly deformation and require structural and seal designers to confirm compatible reaction and water resistance. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: High reaction can crack groove edges before leakage appears, and damaged geometry then undermines sealing. Rubber-only material tests do not reveal this coupled system failure mechanism under assembly loading.
units.failure: 高反力可在尚未出現滲漏前損傷溝槽邊緣，裂損後幾何又降低密封效果；只用橡膠材料試驗無法看出這種系統性反作用。~High reaction can crack groove edges before leakage appears, and damaged geometry then undermines sealing. Rubber-only material tests do not reveal this coupled system failure mechanism under assembly loading.
units.misconception: 止水墊反力越大越好，不必檢查混凝土溝槽劈裂。~Greater gasket reaction is always better without checking concrete groove splitting.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄壓縮反力與混凝土的資料來源與適用條件。以實際溝槽試件量測力位移並檢查混凝土裂縫，對照環片配筋與角部細節；試驗須涵蓋組裝變形，結構及止水設計者共同確認力與水密的相容性。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for compression force and concrete. Measure load-displacement in representative grooves and inspect concrete cracking against reinforcement and corner details; include assembly deformation and require structural and seal designers to confirm compatible reaction and water resistance.

units.anchor: 長期應力鬆弛~Long-term stress relaxation
units.title: 長期應力鬆弛~Long-term stress relaxation
units.mechanism: 橡膠維持壓縮時接觸力可能隨時間下降，溫度與介質改變又影響老化。初始反力不是永久反力，壓縮永久變形和應力鬆弛也不是同一指標，必須按功能分別檢驗。 假設初始接觸力100 kN、特定試驗後70 kN，力保留70%；不得由此直接推算實際50年壽命。 外觀無裂紋不表示接觸力未下降，使用不適當加速因子又可能誇大壽命；若老化後接縫再張開，原先短期試驗的水密證據不足以涵蓋。~Compressed rubber can lose contact force over time, with temperature and medium affecting aging. Initial reaction is not permanent reaction, and compression set differs from stress relaxation; the two need separate functional assessment. Assume initial contact force 100 kN and 70 kN after a specified test; retention is 70%, not a direct prediction of 50-year service life. An uncracked appearance does not prove retained contact force, and an inappropriate acceleration factor exaggerates life. Subsequent joint opening can exceed what the original short-term test actually demonstrated.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設初始接觸力100 kN、特定試驗後70 kN，力保留70%；不得由此直接推算實際50年壽命。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume initial contact force 100 kN and 70 kN after a specified test; retention is 70%, not a direct prediction of 50-year service life.
units.verify: 核對加速老化試驗的溫度、時間及液體環境，測量老化後力位移與水密而非只看外觀；材料工程師需說明時間溫度外推的適用範圍，保留實際長期資料作核對。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：外觀無裂紋不表示接觸力未下降，使用不適當加速因子又可能誇大壽命；若老化後接縫再張開，原先短期試驗的水密證據不足以涵蓋。~Review accelerated-aging temperature, duration and medium and test aged force-displacement and watertightness, not appearance alone; materials engineers justify extrapolation scope and compare available long-term observations. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: An uncracked appearance does not prove retained contact force, and an inappropriate acceleration factor exaggerates life. Subsequent joint opening can exceed what the original short-term test actually demonstrated.
units.failure: 外觀無裂紋不表示接觸力未下降，使用不適當加速因子又可能誇大壽命；若老化後接縫再張開，原先短期試驗的水密證據不足以涵蓋。~An uncracked appearance does not prove retained contact force, and an inappropriate acceleration factor exaggerates life. Subsequent joint opening can exceed what the original short-term test actually demonstrated.
units.misconception: 橡膠外觀沒有裂紋就證明接觸力沒有長期鬆弛。~An uncracked rubber appearance proves that contact force has not relaxed over time.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄長期應力鬆弛的資料來源與適用條件。核對加速老化試驗的溫度、時間及液體環境，測量老化後力位移與水密而非只看外觀；材料工程師需說明時間溫度外推的適用範圍，保留實際長期資料作核對。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for long-term stress relaxation. Review accelerated-aging temperature, duration and medium and test aged force-displacement and watertightness, not appearance alone; materials engineers justify extrapolation scope and compare available long-term observations.

units.anchor: 角部與交叉接點~Corners and intersecting joints
units.title: 角部與交叉接點~Corners and intersecting joints
units.mechanism: 止水線在角部轉向並與其他接縫相交，局部壓縮和橡膠接合品質更複雜。直線段水密不能替代角部試驗，三維錯台或接縫轉角可能沿轉折處形成連續通道。 假設四角中一角存在未驗證接合，未覆蓋比例25%；角部風險不能用其占總周長很小而忽略。 角部接合微缺陷可能在低壓時不漏、變形後才連通，檢查只沿直線段便會漏失；若修補改變角部厚度，也可能使鄰近壓縮不均。~At corners the sealing line turns and meets other joints, creating complex local compression and rubber connections. Straight-length watertightness does not represent corners, where three-dimensional offset or rotation may create a continuous leakage route. If 1 of 4 assumed corners has an unverified connection, corner coverage is missing 25%; its small fraction of total perimeter does not justify ignoring the risk. A small corner-connection defect may leak only after deformation, escaping straight-length inspection. Repairs that alter corner thickness can additionally create uneven compression immediately beside the repaired location.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設四角中一角存在未驗證接合，未覆蓋比例25%；角部風險不能用其占總周長很小而忽略。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 1 of 4 assumed corners has an unverified connection, corner coverage is missing 25%; its small fraction of total perimeter does not justify ignoring the risk.
units.verify: 使用含實際角部和接縫交會的試件，記錄各向錯台與漏點位置；生產檢查保留角部接合和尺寸證據，任何修補由供應者及品質主管核准，不以直線拉伸試驗代替。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：角部接合微缺陷可能在低壓時不漏、變形後才連通，檢查只沿直線段便會漏失；若修補改變角部厚度，也可能使鄰近壓縮不均。~Use specimens with actual corners and joint intersections, recording offsets and leak locations; retain production evidence for corner joining and dimensions and approve repairs through supplier and quality leads rather than substituting straight-strip tensile tests. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A small corner-connection defect may leak only after deformation, escaping straight-length inspection. Repairs that alter corner thickness can additionally create uneven compression immediately beside the repaired location.
units.failure: 角部接合微缺陷可能在低壓時不漏、變形後才連通，檢查只沿直線段便會漏失；若修補改變角部厚度，也可能使鄰近壓縮不均。~A small corner-connection defect may leak only after deformation, escaping straight-length inspection. Repairs that alter corner thickness can additionally create uneven compression immediately beside the repaired location.
units.misconception: 直線墊條試驗合格就可以省略全部角部交會試驗。~Passing straight-strip tests makes all corner-intersection testing unnecessary.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄角部與交叉接點的資料來源與適用條件。使用含實際角部和接縫交會的試件，記錄各向錯台與漏點位置；生產檢查保留角部接合和尺寸證據，任何修補由供應者及品質主管核准，不以直線拉伸試驗代替。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for corners and intersecting joints. Use specimens with actual corners and joint intersections, recording offsets and leak locations; retain production evidence for corner joining and dimensions and approve repairs through supplier and quality leads rather than substituting straight-strip tensile tests.

units.anchor: 黏貼與表面相容~Bonding and surface compatibility
units.title: 黏貼與表面相容~Bonding and surface compatibility
units.mechanism: 黏貼使止水墊在運輸和組裝前維持位置，但最終水密仍依賴正確壓縮與連續接觸。溝槽污染、含水和不相容材料可能降低固定效果，必須遵循核准產品系統而非任意混用。 假設長2 m墊條有0.1 m未固定，缺失長度5%；即使比例小，局部移位仍可能切斷止水線。 運輸中脫落再臨時塞回可能留下扭轉，外觀似乎就位卻接觸不連續；不相容材料也可能讓橡膠膨潤，尺寸正確不代表長期功能正常。~Bonding holds a gasket through handling and assembly, but final sealing still depends on compression and continuous contact. Contamination, moisture and incompatible materials weaken retention, requiring an approved system rather than improvised substitutions. If an assumed 2 m strip has 0.1 m unretained, the missing length is 5%; a small displaced portion can still interrupt the sealing line. A strip that detaches and is hastily reseated may remain twisted with discontinuous contact. Incompatible materials can swell rubber, so apparently correct dimensions do not establish sustained functionality.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設長2 m墊條有0.1 m未固定，缺失長度5%；即使比例小，局部移位仍可能切斷止水線。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed 2 m strip has 0.1 m unretained, the missing length is 5%; a small displaced portion can still interrupt the sealing line.
units.verify: 按供應者核准方法檢查表面狀態、材料批次及固定品質，安裝前核對是否移位或扭曲；任何相容性變更須有試驗與審查，課程不指定黏著劑、溶劑或施工配方。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：運輸中脫落再臨時塞回可能留下扭轉，外觀似乎就位卻接觸不連續；不相容材料也可能讓橡膠膨潤，尺寸正確不代表長期功能正常。~Inspect surface condition, batch and retention under the supplier-approved method and check displacement or twisting before assembly; compatibility changes require tests and review, with no adhesive, solvent or application recipe prescribed here. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A strip that detaches and is hastily reseated may remain twisted with discontinuous contact. Incompatible materials can swell rubber, so apparently correct dimensions do not establish sustained functionality.
units.failure: 運輸中脫落再臨時塞回可能留下扭轉，外觀似乎就位卻接觸不連續；不相容材料也可能讓橡膠膨潤，尺寸正確不代表長期功能正常。~A strip that detaches and is hastily reseated may remain twisted with discontinuous contact. Incompatible materials can swell rubber, so apparently correct dimensions do not establish sustained functionality.
units.misconception: 止水墊黏貼固定良好就可以不考慮最終接縫壓縮。~Secure gasket bonding eliminates the need to consider final joint compression.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄黏貼與表面相容的資料來源與適用條件。按供應者核准方法檢查表面狀態、材料批次及固定品質，安裝前核對是否移位或扭曲；任何相容性變更須有試驗與審查，課程不指定黏著劑、溶劑或施工配方。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for bonding and surface compatibility. Inspect surface condition, batch and retention under the supplier-approved method and check displacement or twisting before assembly; compatibility changes require tests and review, with no adhesive, solvent or application recipe prescribed here.

units.anchor: 安裝污染與局部缺陷~Assembly contamination and local defects
units.title: 安裝污染與局部缺陷~Assembly contamination and local defects
units.mechanism: 砂粒、混凝土碎屑與墊條折疊會把連續接觸切成局部橋接，水沿未壓緊處繞行。這類缺陷不一定改變整體縫寬，因此需要可追溯外觀檢查與後續漏點對照。 假設一條2 m密封線有5 mm夾雜區，占0.25%；此比例不能代表水密損失只有0.25%。 增大組裝力可能把硬碎屑壓進橡膠並切傷，短時閉合更緊卻留下長期漏道；若缺陷照片未保留，後續漏水容易被錯怪為材料老化。~Grit, concrete chips and folded rubber interrupt continuous contact and let water bypass uncompressed areas. Such defects need not change the overall gap, requiring traceable visual checks and later comparison with leakage locations. An assumed 5 mm contaminated patch along a 2 m sealing line is 0.25%; it does not imply only 0.25% loss of watertight performance. More closure force can embed hard debris and cut rubber, producing tighter initial closure but a lasting path. Without defect photographs, later leakage may be wrongly attributed to material aging.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設一條2 m密封線有5 mm夾雜區，占0.25%；此比例不能代表水密損失只有0.25%。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 5 mm contaminated patch along a 2 m sealing line is 0.25%; it does not imply only 0.25% loss of watertight performance.
units.verify: 於核准組裝檢查點拍攝墊條連續性與槽面，記錄缺陷方位、環片序號及處置；發現夾雜或折疊需由品質負責人依程序處理，不能用增加閉合力自動彌補。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：增大組裝力可能把硬碎屑壓進橡膠並切傷，短時閉合更緊卻留下長期漏道；若缺陷照片未保留，後續漏水容易被錯怪為材料老化。~Photograph continuity and groove condition at approved inspection points with position, serial and response; quality leads resolve contamination or folds through the procedure rather than automatically applying more closure force. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: More closure force can embed hard debris and cut rubber, producing tighter initial closure but a lasting path. Without defect photographs, later leakage may be wrongly attributed to material aging.
units.failure: 增大組裝力可能把硬碎屑壓進橡膠並切傷，短時閉合更緊卻留下長期漏道；若缺陷照片未保留，後續漏水容易被錯怪為材料老化。~More closure force can embed hard debris and cut rubber, producing tighter initial closure but a lasting path. Without defect photographs, later leakage may be wrongly attributed to material aging.
units.misconception: 夾雜硬顆粒時增加閉合力必定能恢復完整止水。~Increasing closure force always restores complete sealing when hard debris is trapped.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄安裝污染與局部缺陷的資料來源與適用條件。於核准組裝檢查點拍攝墊條連續性與槽面，記錄缺陷方位、環片序號及處置；發現夾雜或折疊需由品質負責人依程序處理，不能用增加閉合力自動彌補。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for assembly contamination and local defects. Photograph continuity and groove condition at approved inspection points with position, serial and response; quality leads resolve contamination or folds through the procedure rather than automatically applying more closure force.

units.anchor: 公差組合與水密包絡~Tolerance combinations and sealing envelope
units.title: 公差組合與水密包絡~Tolerance combinations and sealing envelope
units.mechanism: 實際接縫同時有張開、錯台與轉角，水密試驗應涵蓋其組合而非各自最大值的孤立試驗。公差統計若有共同模具偏差也不獨立，分析須保留最不利但合理的情境。 假設兩個獨立尺寸標準差1與2 mm，合成2.24 mm；若同向系統偏差則直接相加3 mm。 錯把共同偏差視為獨立會低估累積縫寬，未試過的張開加錯台組合又可能成為現地常態；高平均通過率不能掩蓋整批偏移。~Real joints combine opening, offset and rotation. Testing needs their combinations rather than isolated maxima, and shared mould bias makes tolerance statistics dependent. Preserve adverse but physically plausible combinations in the sealing envelope. Two assumed independent dimensional standard deviations of 1 and 2 mm combine to 2.24 mm; same-direction systematic biases instead add to 3 mm. Treating shared bias as independent understates accumulated gap, while untested opening-offset combinations may be routine in the field. A high average pass rate cannot conceal a systematic batch displacement.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩個獨立尺寸標準差1與2 mm，合成2.24 mm；若同向系統偏差則直接相加3 mm。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Two assumed independent dimensional standard deviations of 1 and 2 mm combine to 2.24 mm; same-direction systematic biases instead add to 3 mm.
units.verify: 將量產尺寸分布與安裝幾何對照試驗包絡，特別查共因偏差和未覆蓋角點；設計者需核准統計假設，超出試驗範圍的組合不能靠單項公差合格直接放行。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：錯把共同偏差視為獨立會低估累積縫寬，未試過的張開加錯台組合又可能成為現地常態；高平均通過率不能掩蓋整批偏移。~Compare production and installed dimensions against the tested envelope, checking common bias and uncovered corners; designers approve statistical assumptions, and combinations outside tested coverage cannot pass solely through individual tolerance compliance. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Treating shared bias as independent understates accumulated gap, while untested opening-offset combinations may be routine in the field. A high average pass rate cannot conceal a systematic batch displacement.
units.failure: 錯把共同偏差視為獨立會低估累積縫寬，未試過的張開加錯台組合又可能成為現地常態；高平均通過率不能掩蓋整批偏移。~Treating shared bias as independent understates accumulated gap, while untested opening-offset combinations may be routine in the field. A high average pass rate cannot conceal a systematic batch displacement.
units.misconception: 共同模具偏差可當作彼此獨立的小誤差互相抵消。~Shared mould biases can be treated as independent small errors that cancel each other.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄公差組合與水密包絡的資料來源與適用條件。將量產尺寸分布與安裝幾何對照試驗包絡，特別查共因偏差和未覆蓋角點；設計者需核准統計假設，超出試驗範圍的組合不能靠單項公差合格直接放行。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for tolerance combinations and sealing envelope. Compare production and installed dimensions against the tested envelope, checking common bias and uncovered corners; designers approve statistical assumptions, and combinations outside tested coverage cannot pass solely through individual tolerance compliance.

units.anchor: 水密試驗與追溯~Watertight tests and traceability
units.title: 水密試驗與追溯~Watertight tests and traceability
units.mechanism: 止水性能屬於橡膠、溝槽、環片與變形條件的整體，供應證書不能取代安裝品質紀錄。結案應讓漏點回溯到產品批次和實際幾何，同時說明哪些老化或變形情境尚未驗證。 假設20組試件有18組達核准要求，通過90%；其餘2組需個別查因，不能用平均結果接受全部。 只留下通過證書而沒有試驗幾何，就無法判斷現地錯台是否被涵蓋；批次或配方更動未登記則切斷證據鏈，後續無從辨認性能差異。~Watertightness belongs to the combined rubber, groove, segment and deformation system. A product certificate does not replace installation records; closeout links leakage to batch and actual geometry and states unverified aging or movement conditions. If 18 of an assumed 20 assemblies meet approved criteria, the pass rate is 90%; the remaining 2 need individual investigation rather than acceptance by averaging. A pass certificate without test geometry cannot show whether field offset was covered. Undocumented batch or formulation changes break the evidence chain and prevent interpreting later differences in performance.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設20組試件有18組達核准要求，通過90%；其餘2組需個別查因，不能用平均結果接受全部。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 18 of an assumed 20 assemblies meet approved criteria, the pass rate is 90%; the remaining 2 need individual investigation rather than acceptance by averaging.
units.verify: 交付原始壓力時間、漏量、位移及照片，核對試件與現地產品和公差是否一致；材料、結構和品質負責人共同確認適用範圍及未解決項，避免把條件性通過寫成無條件保證。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只留下通過證書而沒有試驗幾何，就無法判斷現地錯台是否被涵蓋；批次或配方更動未登記則切斷證據鏈，後續無從辨認性能差異。~Deliver raw pressure-time, leakage, displacement and photographs and check agreement with field products and tolerances; materials, structural and quality leads confirm applicability and unresolved items rather than turning conditional evidence into an unconditional guarantee. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A pass certificate without test geometry cannot show whether field offset was covered. Undocumented batch or formulation changes break the evidence chain and prevent interpreting later differences in performance.
units.failure: 只留下通過證書而沒有試驗幾何，就無法判斷現地錯台是否被涵蓋；批次或配方更動未登記則切斷證據鏈，後續無從辨認性能差異。~A pass certificate without test geometry cannot show whether field offset was covered. Undocumented batch or formulation changes break the evidence chain and prevent interpreting later differences in performance.
units.misconception: 產品通過證書可以取代現地接縫幾何和批次追溯。~A product pass certificate replaces field joint geometry and batch traceability.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄水密試驗與追溯的資料來源與適用條件。交付原始壓力時間、漏量、位移及照片，核對試件與現地產品和公差是否一致；材料、結構和品質負責人共同確認適用範圍及未解決項，避免把條件性通過寫成無條件保證。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for watertight tests and traceability. Deliver raw pressure-time, leakage, displacement and photographs and check agreement with field products and tolerances; materials, structural and quality leads confirm applicability and unresolved items rather than turning conditional evidence into an unconditional guarantee.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設有效原高20 mm、壓後15 mm，壓縮率(20−15)/20=25%；非任何產品的允收值。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水水頭50 m，壓差ρgh=0.4905 MPa；這是教學換算，未含設計裕度及暫態。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume effective initial height 20 mm and compressed height 15 mm; compression is 25%, not an acceptance value for any product. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed fresh-water head of 50 m gives ρgh=0.4905 MPa, a teaching conversion excluding design allowance and transients. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示把止水墊壓縮、接縫偏移與長期鬆弛連到可驗證的水密性需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why connect gasket compression, joint offset and long-term relaxation to verifiable watertightness requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設有效原高20 mm、壓後15 mm，壓縮率(20−15)/20=25%；非任何產品的允收值。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume effective initial height 20 mm and compressed height 15 mm; compression is 25%, not an acceptance value for any product.

教學量化備忘：假設淡水水頭50 m，壓差ρgh=0.4905 MPa；這是教學換算，未含設計裕度及暫態。~Teaching quantitative note: An assumed fresh-water head of 50 m gives ρgh=0.4905 MPa, a teaching conversion excluding design allowance and transients.

教學量化備忘：假設簡化接觸寬30 mm、錯台5 mm，幾何重疊25 mm、保留83.3%；未包含橡膠側向變形。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume nominal contact width 30 mm and offset 5 mm; geometric overlap is 25 mm or 83.3%, excluding lateral rubber deformation.

教學量化備忘：假設每米密封線反力30 kN/m、長2 m，合力60 kN；局部溝槽應力仍需接觸面積與構造分析。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume line reaction 30 kN/m over 2 m; total force is 60 kN, while groove stress still requires contact area and detailing analysis.

教學量化備忘：假設初始接觸力100 kN、特定試驗後70 kN，力保留70%；不得由此直接推算實際50年壽命。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume initial contact force 100 kN and 70 kN after a specified test; retention is 70%, not a direct prediction of 50-year service life.

教學量化備忘：假設四角中一角存在未驗證接合，未覆蓋比例25%；角部風險不能用其占總周長很小而忽略。~Teaching quantitative note: If 1 of 4 assumed corners has an unverified connection, corner coverage is missing 25%; its small fraction of total perimeter does not justify ignoring the risk.
